title: 6-WEEK BEGINNER GOLF PROTOCOL
tagline: IMPROVE MOBILITY. BUILD BETTER MOVEMENT. DEVELOP A STRONGER SWING.

overview.title: FOUNDATIONS
overview.focus: Establish mobility, posture and movement control.

overview.title: BUILD MOVEMENT RANGE
overview.focus: Improve active mobility, refine control, and connect mobility to golf mechanics.

overview.title: BUILD ROTATIONAL STABILITY
overview.focus: Integrate mobility with strength and coordination. Develop control through rotation, balance and sequencing.

overview.title: INTEGRATE MOVEMENT & SWING
overview.focus: Combine mobility, strength and control. Begin to connect movement patterns to a repeatable golf swing with smooth sequencing.

overview.title: CONFIDENCE & CONSISTENCY
overview.focus: Bring it all together. Combine mobility, strength and sequencing to perform a repeatable, efficient golf swing with control.

weeks.label: Week 1
weeks.focus: FOUNDATIONS: Establish mobility, posture and movement control.
weeks.notes:
WEEK 1
FOUNDATIONS
Establish mobility, posture and movement control.

WORKOUT A FOCUS:
- Hip mobility and glute engagement
- Neutral spine and proper golf posture
- Controlled movement through a comfortable range
- Quality over speed

WORKOUT B FOCUS:
- Thoracic spine mobility
- Shoulder control and posture
- Upper-body rotation and stability
- Maintain a relaxed, athletic upper body

WORKOUT C FOCUS:
- Glute activation and hip stability
- Lower-body mobility and balance
- Control through full range of motion
- Proper weight transfer and stance awareness

WEEK 1
3 WORKOUTS
20-30 MINUTES EACH
MOBILITY FIRST. FORM ALWAYS.
BEGINNER GOLF PROTOCOL

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.focus: BUILD MOVEMENT RANGE: Improve active mobility, refine control, and connect mobility to golf mechanics.
weeks.notes:
WEEK 2
BUILD MOVEMENT RANGE
Improve active mobility, refine control, and connect mobility to golf mechanics.

WORKOUT A FOCUS:
- Increase hip internal/external rotation
- Improve pelvic control
- Activate glutes and lateral hip stabilizers
- Build a stable base for the golf swing

WORKOUT B FOCUS:
- Improve thoracic spine mobility
- Develop scapular control and shoulder stability
- Maintain a relaxed upper body
- Learn a controlled takeaawy position

WORKOUT C FOCUS:
- Improve single-leg stability and balance
- Strengthen glutes and posterior chain
- Enhance lower-body control in rotation
- Connect movement to a stable, balanced backswing

WEEK 2
3 WORKOUTS
20-30 MINUTES EACH
MOBILITY FIRST. FORM ALWAYS.
BEGINNER GOLF PROTOCOL

WEEK 5
INTEGRATE MOVEMENT & SWING
Combine mobility, strength and control. Begin to connect movement patterns to a repeatable golf swing with smooth sequencing.

WORKOUT A FOCUS:
- Increase hip and thoracic rotation
- Build a stable, athletic posture
- Learn to load into the backswing with control
- Connect lower-body stability to upper-body movement

WORKOUT B FOCUS:
- Single-leg stability and balance
- Dynamic hip control and glute engagement
- Smooth weight transfer and transition
- Build control through the impact position

WORKOUT C FOCUS:
- Full-body mobility and coordination
- Connect upper and lower body
- Develop a smooth, repeatable swing motion
- Maintain balance and posture through the finish
